songs.title: your voice gets here first
songs.description: Warm soul pop for a cafe, E major, 96 BPM. Male low baritone, half voice, near speech, as if humming to himself, no female vocals. Narrow melody in a fourth, one phrase returning; the chorus keeps those notes and lifts because the band opens, not because he pushes; lines end early. Rounded consonants, almost no vibrato. Full band, dense and soft: Wurlitzer, four-note motif, struck short; chorused guitar in off-beat chords; one harmony voice, last chorus, no choir; felt-muted bass, short dotted notes; soft kit, brushed snare, shaker every bar, never dropping out. Harmony Emaj9 - G#7 - C#m9 - Amaj9 - B9 to Emaj9, the third chord made dominant. Vocals behind the band, blended in, not upfront. Warm tone, softened top, tape warmth, lo-fi. Ends on a plucked chord, about two and a half minutes, the lyric filling all of it. One note per syllable, the band carrying every lift. No melisma, no sustained high notes, no head voice, no saxophone, no smoky bar or lounge, no autotune, no pop gloss.

Narrow melody in a fourth, one phrase returning; the chorus keeps those notes and lifts because the band opens, not because she pushes; lines end early. Rounded consonants, almost no vibrato. Full band, dense and soft: tape piano, low, three-note motif, struck short; a soft mellotron bed, far back; one harmony voice, last chorus, no choir; deep bass in short eighths; low tom, rim click, hats every bar, never dropping out. Harmony Am9 - Dm9 - G9 to Cmaj9, each chord a fifth below the last, walking the minor home. Vocals behind the band, blended in, not upfront. Dark warm tone, highs rolled off, lo-fi. Ends on a plucked chord, about two and a half minutes, the lyric filling all of it. One note per syllable, the band carrying every lift. No melisma, no sustained high notes, no head voice, no saxophone, no smoky bar or lounge, no autotune, no pop gloss.
